I am Dan Goldman, a lifelong resident of lower Manhattan, a husband to Corinne and proud father of five, and a prosecutor who has spent a decade fighting the very forces that threaten our communities. From the streets of Brooklyn to the halls of the Southern District of New York, I have held powerful actors accountable—prosecuting violent gangs, dismantling mafia and Russian organized crime, and defeating the biggest cases of insider trading and corporate fraud. In 2019, I served as lead counsel on the impeachment investigation of President Donald J. Trump, standing firm against the abuse of office for personal gain and testifying before the House Judiciary Committee to protect the integrity of our democracy. My work, guided by a commitment to justice and fairness, is rooted in a belief that every New Yorker deserves a city that is safe, transparent, and equitable. I ask for your support so we can continue to build a future where accountability, safety, and integrity are not just ideals, but everyday realities for all of us.

Citizens of New York, I’m Dan Goldman, a lawyer, a husband and father of five, and a lifelong defender of truth and justice. For a decade I served as an Assistant United States Attorney in the Southern District of New York, prosecuting violent gangs, gun traffickers, mafia bosses, Russian organized crime and major corporate fraud—making our streets safer and our courts fairer. In 2019 I led the impeachment investigation that held President Trump accountable for abusing his office, proving that no one is above the law. My work on Michelle Alexander’s “The New Jim Crow” has taught me how systemic inequities erode our communities, and I’ve committed to dismantling those barriers. As mayor, I will bring that same relentless integrity to every corner of the city: strengthening public safety, rooting out corruption, protecting families, and ensuring that justice is truly equal for all. Join me in building a New York that lives up to its promise of opportunity, safety, and fairness—because a city that holds itself accountable is a city that thrives.

Juanita is the mother of four grown children and a grandmother. She sits on several Central New York Boards including La Liga (Spanish Action League), Clear Path for Veterans, CNY Workforce Investment Board, Bishop Ludden High School Trustee, is co-founder of UMEA, the new minority chamber of commerce, and is a proud member of the Valley American Legion.

Steve and his wife, Cathy, currently reside in Peachtree Corners and have two children, Michael and Savannah. # Candidate Name

# Candidate Bio
My family immigrated to the Valley, where we have been farming for 112 years. Our story is the American story of immigration, families who come here to build a better life.

Now more than ever, we need leaders with the experience to find common sense solutions to the problems we face. As your Congressman, I work hard to get things done for our Valley.

Nothing is as important to our Valleys future as a clean and reliable water supply. Over the past two years, weve been successful in providing more flexibility for water managers and Valley farmers and will continue to push for more water, including funding to improve our infrastructure and build more storage.

Ive championed comprehensive immigration reform, keeping families together and protecting the Dreamers from the uncertainty no one should have to endure.
Since 2010, the number of uninsured people in our Congressional district has dropped by half, but affordable healthcare will always be a priority. Im continuing my work to expand healthcare, increasing funding for our community hospitals and health clinics and making drug prices affordable.

To ensure our veterans get what theyve earned, I secured funding to open the Fresno Veterans Home and worked to improve access for veterans healthcare.

Weve brought tax dollars back to our Valley  improving roads, hiring police officers, funding schools and colleges and passing a Farm Bill that keeps Valley agriculture growing.

We have more to do  join my efforts to reinvest in our future and keep our Valley strong.

The grandson of Portuguese immigrants, Congressman Jim Costa is an active third-generation family farmer and lifelong San Joaquin Valley resident. restoration of the WWI Liberty Memorial;
the reconstruction and beautification of Brush Creek; and
the expansion and renovation of Bartle Hall.
The Congressman and his wife, Dianne, along with their four children and five grandchildren, have lived in Kansas City for more than forty years. For thirty-seven of those years, he served as the Senior Pastor at St. James United Methodist Church, a post which one of their sons now holds.

I am Courtney Geels, a proud North Carolinian born into generations of families who have called this state home, and a nurse who has spent her career standing in the front lines of our hospitals—where I learned that the most powerful healers are the ones who listen, advocate, and refuse to settle for bad care. When a loved one is in the emergency room, the nurse’s voice can mean the difference between life and death; that was why I chose nursing, why I chose to bring the same relentless passion to the halls of Congress. I will fight for policies that protect the people of North Carolina and our nation from the influence of special interests, big tech, and progressive agendas that erode our civil liberties. With the unwavering support of my husband Bryan, I promise to restore the conservative values that built our great country—truth, justice, and unity—and to bring a voice of common sense and steadfast conservatism to Washington. Join me in giving North Carolina a strong, principled voice, uniting our nation through truth, preserving liberty for all, and putting the power back in the hands of the people.
